title: The Hands That Kept It
summary: Keep a workshop company alive as the Recall reaches Tessell. Rescue fitters, defend repair yards and earn the salvage that turns four patched walkers into a force with a say in who owns them.

opening.title: Four names on a list
body: The notice arrives during a repair shift. The Aurelian Continuance claims every surviving walker root left by its predecessor, including the four in your yard. Halloran offers a contract to reopen Marker Eleven before its ownership records are taken away. Your company accepts because those records include your own machines.

You command Linewrought: local pilots, mismatched armour and guns the workshops can keep supplied. Halloran needs its crossings; Sarn needs working gantries. Neither can pay you in loyalty. Bring crews home, choose useful salvage and keep enough money for the next repair. The first job is to clear the registry guard.

chapters.title: The workshops answer
body: Marker Eleven is copied. The rolls describe serials, but the margins hold workshop names, repair dates and the people who kept those machines running. One fresh reader entry points to a recovery cut west of Sarn. A crew there has stopped answering. The company can reach them before Kestrel does.
Halloran also posts local work that can provide parts and proof. Those notices remain optional; The Quiet Claim is the next main operation.

chapters.title: A crew brought home
body: The recovery cradle clears the yard with its fitters alive. Their machinery and field notes arrive in your stores as useful equipment, not a promise. They also bring news: Kestrel followed the service route to Sarn's repair halls. Keeping one workshop open could matter more than winning another stretch of empty road.

chapters.title: The lights stay on
body: Sarn's gantries finish their shift behind your guns. The shopworkers remember the company that stayed, and their stock transfer gives your fitters something concrete to work with. A company can live off wrecks for a while. A district survives because someone can still put them back together.

chapters.title: White armour in the yard
body: The first Aurelian claim detail is beaten. Its precise emitters and factory-fitted armour are real advantages; so are the gaps your company found in its formation. Halloran has waived its share of the recoverable Stock. If a machine survives recovery, it can fight beside yours. The common mounts accept mixed weapons; heat, ammunition and scarce replacements still have to be paid for.

chapters.title: A rule worth keeping
body: Sarn retains the recording of Kestrel firing after an ejected pilot. Wreckright gives the ground-holder the wreck. It also gives the pilot a way home. Breaking that second rule threatens every crew on Tessell, including yours. Kestrel has lost the yard, but its cut to Sarn's power trunk has left the western repair halls cold.

chapters.title: Power and proof
body: The load transfers and the repair halls regain power. Among Sarn's service records is an address leading toward the old depot manifest: the clearest surviving record of Tessell's walker roots. Halloran wants the approach opened. Your company is now strong enough to reach evidence that could decide the Recall, rather than merely survive its next contract.

chapters.title: Behind the depot doors
body: Barrow is open. The master manifest can be held intact, giving Tessell evidence and making the company its keeper. It can be burned, denying the Authority its strongest seizure record while destroying a century of service history with it. Halloran got the company through the door. It cannot choose what the company is willing to carry.
These are alternative endings. Either concludes the campaign without requiring every optional posting.

chapters.title: A claim without a ledger
body: The master manifest burns. The Recall loses its strongest seizure record, and Tessell’s workshops gain time to decide their own future. The same fire takes certified service histories, witness chains and proof that could have supported local stewardship.

Sarn’s gantries remain lit, but every future claim will be argued from scattered copies and living memory. The company leaves Barrow as the force that made the choice. Its victory is real and its responsibility permanent.

chapters.title: Keepers of the record
body: The manifest survives under the company’s seal. Tessell has evidence that its workshops maintained the roots the Continuance abandoned, and the Authority must negotiate with people it first counted as inventory. The record does not erase copied serials or the shortages beyond Tessell. It prevents either side from erasing the other.

Sarn’s gantries remain lit. The rescued fitters return machines to service, including captured Stock when the parts can be made to fit. The company leaves Barrow stronger and answerable for what the record is used to justify.
